changeSet.sql: create function archiv_tags_text(tags text[]) returns text language sql immutable parallel safe as $$ select coalesce(array_to_string(tags, ' '), '') $$

create function dokument_version_nur_einfuegen() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin raise exception 'dokument_version: nur Einfügen erlaubt (% verweigert)', tg_op using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege'; end $$
